title: refactor(oracle): simplify repository zip packaging
body:
## Change Summary

- Simplify the Oracle repo zip helper to a minimal `--prompt` plus `--output` CLI.
- Generate a package root `AGENTS.md` from the prompt and place the repository checkout one directory below it with `.git` intact.
- Remove the old `_repo_zip_context`/manifest flow and the Jinja2 template dependency.
- Update the Oracle skill workflow docs to match the new package layout.

## Related

- Thread: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e834b-b038-7395-bd8f-d55f0a04c058

## Verification

- `skillshare sync --json`
- `uvx ruff check skills-stable/oracle/scripts/zip.py`
- `uvx ruff format --check skills-stable/oracle/scripts/zip.py`
- `uv run --script skills-stable/oracle/scripts/zip.py --help`
- Built a test zip and verified the package root `AGENTS.md` plus nested repo `.git` layout.
- Commit and pre-push hooks passed.
